title: Basic Properties
html:
Let |||⋅||| be a unitarily invariant norm on Mm×n(F), with gauge Φ as in @lem-ui-norm-of-diagonal, and let A∈Mm×n(F).

  1. σ(A∗)=σ(A); consequently, if |||⋅|||′ is the unitarily invariant norm on Mn×m(F) attached to the same gauge Φ by @thm-von-neumann-correspondence, then |||A∗|||′=|||A|||. For m=n this reads |||A∗|||=|||A|||.
  2. |||XA|||≤‖X‖2|||A||| for every X∈Mm(F), and |||AY|||≤|||A|||‖Y‖2 for every Y∈Mn(F).
  3. If |||⋅||| is normalized, meaning |||e1e1∗|||=1 for the m×n matrix e1e1∗ with a single 1 in position (1,1), then ‖A‖2 ≤ |||A||| ≤ |||A|||(p).
  4. A normalized unitarily invariant norm on Mn(F) is submultiplicative: |||AB|||≤|||A||||||B|||.
